context: 1964 U.S. Presidential Campaign advertisement ('Peace, Little Girl' / 'Daisy'), contrasting childhood innocence with nuclear annihilation to drive urgent electoral mobilization.

beliefDimensions.name: Existential Nuclear Threat & Anti-War Urgency
beliefDimensions.description: Perception of imminent nuclear annihilation and rejection of catastrophic military escalation.

beliefDimensions.name: Electoral & Institutional Mobilization
beliefDimensions.description: Directive compliance with civic voting duty ('Vote for President Johnson on November 3rd').

beliefDimensions.name: Collective Survival & Peace Stewardship
beliefDimensions.description: Framing leadership as the necessary guardian of collective survival ('make a world in which all of God's children can live').

beliefDimensions.name: Innocence & Vulnerability Preservation
beliefDimensions.description: Identification with the vulnerable child in nature threatened by impersonal state/military machinery.

segments.transcript: One, two, three, four, five, seven, six, six, eight, nine, nine...

visualEvidence.setting: Sunlit outdoor meadow with birds chirping

archetypes.evidence: Young girl miscounting daisy petals in nature

segments.transcript: Ten, nine, eight, seven, six, five, four, three, two, one, zero!

visualEvidence.setting: Freeze-frame and extreme step-zoom into the girl's right eye pupil

archetypes.evidence: Booming metallic countdown overriding the child's voice

segments.speakerLabel: President Lyndon B. Johnson (Voiceover over Nuclear Detonation)
segments.transcript: [Nuclear explosion roar] These are the stakes! To make a world in which all of God's children can live, or to go into the dark. We must either love each other, or we must die.

visualEvidence.setting: Blinding white flash followed by roiling nuclear fireball and mushroom cloud

archetypes.evidence: Full-screen atomic detonation and mushroom cloud
To make a world in which all of God's children can live

segments.transcript: Vote for President Johnson on November 3rd. The stakes are too high for you to stay home.

visualEvidence.setting: Black screen with bold white typography
